name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 24 – Am 66
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 24a. Demands that the EU stop funding illegal migration, financing progressive left-wing media attacking Member States’ sovereignty and promoting the spread of woke propaganda or war propaganda from the EU budget; requests in this regard that both direct and indirect support channelled through non-governmental organisations (NGOs) be ended and no money should be spent on promoting the Commission’s false political agenda;
